Team / Elena — kicking off a short sweep to lock the Helios Health bookings that will land in the Q4 ARR appendix. Goal: confirm stage gating, evidence for each commit, and any timing risks we need to flag to finance before the board packet publish next week.

High level asks (owners in parens):
- Confirm contract signature ETA and DocuSign link (Elena / Procurement)
- Attach the deal journal export and one-line acceptance criteria for each opportunity that we plan to count (Laura)
- Verify billing start date / first invoice and whether revenue recognition is on schedule (Vanessa)
- Call out any gating items that would push bookings outside this quarter (all)

I've attached an ARR_evidence_package_v1.pdf with the checklist and a blank Helios-deal-journal.xlsx. Please drop docs into the Drive folder linked below and reply with updates by EOD Monday (Oct 19). If we get any redlines on terms that affect pricing or delivery dates, flag them to me immediately.

Elena — I know you said procurement was close last call. If the DocuSign link is ready, paste it in the thread and we'll mark the deal as commit-ready pending signature. If not, please include the blocker and an ETA.

Thanks — short and practical here. We need evidence we can hand to finance and the board.

Ben
